name: applied_no_tracker_entries
label: Have you applied to GALLUMPELL within the last 12 months?

name: applied_other_company_only
label: Have you applied to GALLUMPELL within the last 12 months?

name: applied_outside_12_month_window
label: Have you applied to GALLUMPELL within the last 12 months?
spec_quote: A tracker application older than the window (e.g. 20 months ago for "last 12-18 months") → No.

name: applied_range_uses_longer_bound_inside_18mo
label: Have you applied to GALLUMPELL within the last 12-18 months?
spec_quote: A window written as a range ("within the last 12-18 months") means the LONGER bound (18 months): the question asks whether any application falls inside the range's span.

name: applied_range_older_than_18mo
label: Have you applied to GALLUMPELL within the last 12-18 months?
spec_quote: A tracker application older than the window (e.g. 20 months ago for "last 12-18 months") → No.

name: applied_spec_example_reminder_with_or_another_role
label: Have you applied to this role or another role @GALLUMPELL within the last 12-18 months? As a reminder, if you have already applied for this position during the current recruitment season and were not selected, you may reapply when the next recruitment season begins in 2027.
spec_quote: A trailing reminder / note sentence that mentions "this position" or "the current recruitment season" ... must NOT turn a question that also says "or another role" into a one-role question.

name: applied_this_position_only_ask
label: Have you applied for this position?
spec_quote: "Have you applied for this position?" (no "or another") with a hit → ask.

name: applied_single_season_question_ask
label: Have you applied to GALLUMPELL during this recruiting season?
spec_quote: A question about ONE role or ONE season ("Have you applied for THIS position?", "during this recruiting season") is not a state the tracker can answer: the rule asks the user instead ("ask").

name: applied_past_2_years_far_back_hit
label: Have you applied to GALLUMPELL in the past 2 years?
spec_quote: the rule answers Yes when the tracker holds an application to that company dated before today and inside the window the question names ("within the last 12 months", "in the past 2 years")

name: applied_future_dated_application_not_counted
label: Have you applied to GALLUMPELL within the last 12 months?
spec_quote: the rule answers Yes when the tracker holds an application to that company dated before today and inside the window

name: ack_standard_lever_stay_connected
label: Stay Connected | To ensure you receive our emails, please add no-reply@hire.lever.co to your safe sender list and check your spam folder.
options: I understand that next steps will be sent via email and I have marked the sender addresses above as safe.
expect: I understand that next steps will be sent via email and I have marked the sender addresses above as safe.
spec_quote: The candidate always ticks it (it is an acknowledgement, no fact about him): the answer is that single option, whatever company domain the notice names.

name: ack_company_domain_mentioned_still_same_option
label: Stay Connected | Add no-reply@hire.lever.co and acme.com to your safe sender list, and check your spam folder so our messages reach you.
options: I understand that next steps will be sent via email and I have marked the sender addresses above as safe.
expect: I understand that next steps will be sent via email and I have marked the sender addresses above as safe.
spec_quote: the answer is that single option, whatever company domain the notice names.

name: ack_multiple_options_not_this_rule
label: Stay Connected | Please add no-reply@hire.lever.co to your safe sender list and check your spam folder.
options: I understand that next steps will be sent via email and I have marked the sender addresses above as safe.
I do not wish to receive email updates.
spec_quote: A label that merely mentions "safe sender list" inside another question, a field with several options, or a box that asks for a fact is NOT this rule (no answer from it).

name: ack_safe_sender_mention_inside_other_question
label: Have you added our sending domain to your safe sender list and checked your spam folder?
spec_quote: A label that merely mentions "safe sender list" inside another question ... is NOT this rule (no answer from it).

name: ack_single_option_but_asks_fact
label: Stay Connected | Are you legally authorized to work in the United States?
spec_quote: a box that asks for a fact is NOT this rule (no answer from it).

name: ack_label_does_not_start_with_stay_connected
label: Deliverability notice: please add no-reply@hire.lever.co to your safe sender list and check your spam folder.
options: I understand that next steps will be sent via email and I have marked the sender addresses above as safe.
spec_quote: its label starts "Stay Connected |" and asks the applicant to add the sender ... to the safe sender list and check spam.

name: overlap_old_list_picks_match_no_option
spec_quote: an older entry that catches the question but gives NO answer on that shape (it is a list-answer entry whose picks match none of the options ...) does not block the save: the new entry answers that shape (newest first) and the older entry keeps answering the shapes it can.

name: overlap_old_list_pick_matches_option_blocks
spec_quote: An older entry that DOES answer on that shape still blocks (two answers for one field = the user decides).

name: overlap_old_list_pick_on_text_box_does_not_block
spec_quote: an older entry that catches the question but gives NO answer on that shape (it is a list-answer entry ... on a text box) does not block the save

name: overlap_old_text_answer_on_text_box_blocks
spec_quote: An older entry that DOES answer on that shape still blocks (two answers for one field = the user decides).

name: overlap_new_entry_catches_old_always_blocks

table.q: Why do you want to join Acme?

new.q: Tell us why you want to join Acme and what excites you.

spec_quote: The "new entry catches an old entry's q" direction always blocks.

name: overlap_no_shape_given_old_behaviour_blocks
spec_quote: When no shape is given the old behaviour holds: every catching entry blocks.

name: overlap_two_old_entries_one_answers_blocks
spec_quote: An older entry that DOES answer on that shape still blocks (two answers for one field = the user decides).

name: overlap_old_pick_no_match_but_new_match_catches_old
spec_quote: The "new entry catches an old entry's q" direction always blocks.

name: overlap_old_pick_matches_one_of_many_options_blocks
spec_quote: An older entry that DOES answer on that shape still blocks (two answers for one field = the user decides).

name: overlap_old_text_answer_matches_an_option_blocks
spec_quote: An older entry that DOES answer on that shape still blocks (two answers for one field = the user decides).

name: overlap_old_text_answer_not_an_option_ambiguous
spec_quote: an older entry that catches the question but gives NO answer on that shape (it is a list-answer entry whose picks match none of the options, or a list-answer entry on a text box) does not block the save — the spec only enumerates list-answer entries as giving no answer; it does not say how a plain-text entry whose text matches none of the field's options behaves.

name: overlap_old_match_regex_catches_new_but_pick_matches_no_option
spec_quote: an older entry that catches the question but gives NO answer on that shape (it is a list-answer entry whose picks match none of the options ...) does not block the save: the new entry answers that shape (newest first) and the older entry keeps answering the shapes it can.
